subject: Data Engineering
title: Watermarks and Late Data
description: A micro-lesson that makes Watermarks and Late Data usable.

hook.text: An event with a 2 PM timestamp arrives at 2:15 PM. The 2 PM window already closed. What now?

buildup.text: Watermarks estimate how far behind the slowest event might be, defining when a window can safely close.

discovery.text: A watermark of 5 minutes means: we believe all events older than 5 minutes have already arrived.

twist.text: Set the watermark too low and you drop valid late events. Too high and your results are delayed.

climax.text: Watermarks are a trade-off between completeness and latency — and the right setting depends on the use case.

punchline.text: Watermarks answer: how long should we wait?
